# G2

> G2 is a leading B2B software review and intelligence platform providing buyer intent data, product intelligence, and market insights across thousands of software categories.

G2 operates a comprehensive ecosystem including documentation for its core products (HubSpot integration, Flow Builder, Buyer Intent), a newsroom for press releases and announcements, and sister brands Capterra, Software Advice, and GetApp. The platform leverages AI and proprietary scoring methodologies to help buyers make informed software decisions and sellers reach qualified prospects.

## Key Topics

## Documentation & Product Guides

- [G2 Documentation Hub](https://documentation.g2.com/): Complete documentation for G2 products including HubSpot integration, Flow Builder, and buyer intent features with technical guides and setup instructions.

- [G2 Newsroom](https://news.g2.com/): Official newsroom featuring press releases, product announcements, software awards, market reports, and industry trends from G2 leadership.
